title: The Burning Bush
summary: God hears His people and calls servants to join His rescue work. This short lesson helps kids read, understand, and play through the passage.

read_it.prompt: Read Exodus 3:1-12 and look for how this passage teaches: God hears His people and calls servants to join His rescue work.

tell_it: Moses saw a bush burning without burning up. God told him He had heard Israel's cries and would send Moses.
understand_it: God hears His people and calls servants to join His rescue work. This lesson keeps the main point simple: God is faithful, His Word is true, and His people can respond with faith and obedience.
age_5_7_explanation: The Burning Bush reminds us that God is good and we can trust Him. Calling matters.
age_8_11_explanation: The Burning Bush shows that following God is not only knowing the story. It means learning this truth: God hears His people and calls servants to join His rescue work.
teen_explanation: The Burning Bush gives older students room to think about faith under pressure. The passage teaches that god hears His people and calls servants to join His rescue work. It also asks how belief becomes action.
key_truths: God hears His people and calls servants to join His rescue work.
God's people can bring real needs and feelings to Him.
God is faithful and His people can trust Him.
life_application: A kid can practice this when calling is needed: at school, with siblings, during disappointment, or when choosing between an easy wrong thing and a harder right thing.

quiz_questions.question: What did God say He had heard?
quiz_questions.explanation: The passage points us back to this answer: The cries of His people. It helps kids remember the main event and the truth it teaches.

quiz_questions.question: This lesson teaches that god hears His people and calls servants to join His rescue work.
quiz_questions.explanation: That is the plain lesson focus for this passage, stated in kid-friendly language.

memory_verse.prompt: Remember Exodus 3:7 as a short anchor for this lesson.

discussion_questions: What happened in The Burning Bush?
What does this passage teach us about God or following Him?
Where could this lesson help you at home, school, church, or with friends?

activity.title: Holy Ground Steps
activity.instructions: Draw or act out the lesson scene, then name the one clear truth: God hears His people and calls servants to join His rescue work.

prayer_prompt: Lord, help me learn from The Burning Bush. Teach me to trust You, listen to Your Word, and live this truth this week.
